category_edits.rationale: Across all four category models, jointly reduce learning rate to 4e-4 and increase dropout to 0.15. Smaller updates and stronger regularization may improve generalization while retaining width 48 and six causal blocks. Existing checkpoint metadata and predictor construction remain compatible; features, scoring, readout, loss, seeds and training limits are preserved.

response.change_summary: Jointly lower learning rate and raise dropout for all four independent NextItNet category models, retaining one checkpoint per category.
